name: turbocat
description: Automated Tomcat deployment with project-local configuration isolation and smart file synchronization for Java web projects

turbocat.logEncoding.markdownDescription: Encoding for Tomcat logs. Accepts any encoding supported by iconv-lite. Set globally as a default or override it for a Workspace Folder.

turbocat.compileEncoding.description: Encoding passed to javac during Local deployments. Set this to match your source file encoding when compiling without Maven or Gradle.

turbocat.logLevel.description: Minimum log level to display. Messages at or above this level will be shown.

turbocat.showTimestamp.description: Whether to include timestamps in log messages.

turbocat.autoShowOutput.description: Whether to automatically show the output panel when logs are written.

turbocat.showSmartDeployLog.description: Show TurboCat smart deploy synchronization messages in the output panel.

turbocat.syncBypassPatterns.description: Comma-separated keywords; files containing these terms in the name are ignored by smart deploy synchronization (case-insensitive).

turbocat.smartDeploy.description: Toggle smart auto-deployment mode. When enabled, only changed files will be automatically deployed.

turbocat.smartDeployDebounce.description: Debounce time in milliseconds for smart deploy to prevent rapid successive deployments.

turbocat.smartDeployReload.description: Restart Tomcat after smart deploy updates classes or resources whose mapping needs a reload. Skipped in debug mode, where the debugger hot-swaps classes.

turbocat.preferredBuildType.markdownDescription: Override build detection when deploying. Auto uses heuristics; select Local, Maven, Gradle, or PreBuilt to force a specific pipeline. PreBuilt skips `mvn` and deploys `target/classes` (compiled by the Java Language Server) + static web resources — ideal when Maven is not on PATH.

turbocat.deployPath.markdownDescription: Override the Tomcat webapp directory relative to `webapps`. Leave empty to deploy using the workspace folder name. For nested folders omit the leading slash (e.g. `web/jmics`).

turbocat.tomcatBase.markdownDescription: Project CATALINA_BASE. Relative paths resolve from the Workspace Folder. Set globally as a default, override per project, or use an empty string to run directly from CATALINA_HOME.

turbocat.debugPort.description: The debug port number for the Tomcat server in debug mode, allowed range is 1024-49151.

turbocat.port.description: The port number for the Tomcat server, allowed range is 1024-49151.

turbocat.shutdownPort.markdownDescription: The Tomcat shutdown port used for receiving the shutdown command. Must differ from `turbocat.port`. Set the Tomcat `server.xml` port to -1 manually if you need to disable the shutdown listener.

turbocat.home.description: The path to the Apache Tomcat installation. If not set, the extension will try to find the Tomcat installation automatically.

turbocat.javaHome.description: Path to the JDK. Set it globally as a default or override it in Workspace/Workspace Folder settings.

turbocat.mavenHome.description: Path to the Maven installation. When set, uses "<mavenHome>/bin/mvn" instead of relying on the system PATH. Useful when mvn is not globally available.

turbocat.tomcatDebugEnvironment.markdownDescription: Environment variables to apply when launching Tomcat in debug mode. Use this to override or extend debug-specific JVM parameters without affecting normal starts.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run compile-tests && npm run lint
scripts.test:unit: npm run compile-tests && mocha out/test/suite/projectDetector.test.js out/test/suite/globPattern.test.js out/test/suite/eclipseMetadataParser.test.js out/test/suite/commandRunner.test.js out/test/suite/directorySynchronizer.test.js out/test/suite/smartDeployCoordinator.test.js
scripts.coverage: npm run compile-tests && nyc --include 'out/services/project/**/*.js' --include 'out/services/build/**/*.js' --include 'out/services/deployment/**/*.js' --exclude 'out/test/**' --exclude-after-remap=false --check-coverage --lines 85 --statements 85 --functions 75 --branches 60 --reporter=text --reporter=lcov mocha out/test/suite/projectDetector.test.js out/test/suite/globPattern.test.js out/test/suite/eclipseMetadataParser.test.js out/test/suite/commandRunner.test.js out/test/suite/directorySynchronizer.test.js out/test/suite/smartDeployCoordinator.test.js
